answer: One daily vote for an AI managing oasis water would require treating 100 L of fresh intake from at least 2 mg/L ferrous iron to below 0.3 mg/L total iron. Independent auditors test chemistry and net flow, excluding ripple-driven reversals; validators bind each batch to one key/day and reject reuse. Failed checks deny the vote. n keys need 100n L/day: treatment work recurs; pumps are reusable capital. Audited intake custody must prevent recontamination; colluding auditors can forge passes. Shared plants can lower unit costs, so this deters free aliases, not wealthy operators.
